summary: Learn practical recruitment, employee records, performance and staff development processes. Explore the five-day HR management training course.
lede: Fundamental human resource practices are the everyday processes that support recruitment, employee records, performance and staff development. For new HR staff, supervisors and professionals taking on people responsibilities, this five-day course builds practical skills in job analysis, structured selection and onboarding. Exercises also cover performance reviews, learning-needs analysis, workforce measures and digital HR workflows.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who handle employee processes directly or supervise teams and need a practical grounding in HR records, recruitment, performance and staff development.
modules: Employee Lifecycle and the Ulrich Model
prerequisites: No prior HR specialization is specified for this foundation-level course. Basic familiarity with workplace procedures will help you connect the exercises to your role. Coding is not required; Excel is used for basic HR calculations and summaries.
